title: A part uses the matrix as saved at the moment it is priced
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Open matrix A in a second browser window, signed in as the same Admin.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click Edit in the second window.
  2. Type 50 as Default's rule in the second window.
  3. Open work order 1 in the first window.
  4. Click Add Part under line 1.
  5. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  6. Type 1 in Qty.
  7. Pick category A in Category.
  8. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  9. Click Save.
  10. Click Save in the second window.
  11. Click Add Part under line 1.
  12. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  13. Type 1 in Qty.
  14. Pick category A in Category.
  15. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  16. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A's grid opens for editing in the second window.

Step 2:

  • Default reads 50 there, not yet saved.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 4:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 5:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 6:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 7:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 8:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 9:

  • The part fills in at $135.00, the saved Markup % 35 ($100.00 × 1.35).

Step 10:

  • Matrix A saves with Default Markup % 50.

Step 11:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 12:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 13:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 14:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 15:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 16:

  • The new part fills in at $150.00 ($100.00 × 1.50).
  • The first part keeps $135.00.
